composition_subtypes.role: sort intervals by min_gap and bridges by length
greedily select smallest max_gap interval to assign bridge

payload.composition_order: 1. sort both lists; 2. iterate bridges, push eligible intervals to heap; 3. pop and assign if max_gap >= bridge, else fail
payload.core_composition_summary: Sort gaps and bridges, then use a min-heap to greedily assign the smallest possible max-gap gap to each bridge.
payload.rationale: The solution uses sorting to order constraints and a priority queue to dynamically manage eligible gaps, combining greedy selection with a heap data structure.
